name: get-login-token-from-credentials
fixture: workspace member with a password, acme origin
query: mutation GetLoginTokenFromCredentials($email: String!, $password: String!, $captchaToken: String, $origin: String!) { getLoginTokenFromCredentials(email: $email, password: $password, captchaToken: $captchaToken, origin: $origin) { loginToken { token expiresAt } } }
